name: myfirstproject
description: Monorepo con web Next.js y API Express, desplegado en Netlify.

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:api
scripts.check: npm run check:web && npm run check:api
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @myfirstproject/api && npm run test --workspace @myfirstproject/web
scripts.build:netlify: npm run prisma:generate --workspace @myfirstproject/api && node scripts/migrar-netlify.mjs && npm run build:web
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace @myfirstproject/api && npm run test:coverage --workspace @myfirstproject/web
